mapper.select: SELECT S.SRCH_PAGE_SN AS SEARCH_PAGE_ID, S.MENU_1DEPTH_NM AS MENU1_DEPTH_NAME, S.MENU_2DEPTH_NM AS MENU2_DEPTH_NAME, S.MENU_3DEPTH_NM AS MENU3_DEPTH_NAME, S.PAGE_TTL AS TITLE, S.PAGE_CN AS CONTENT, S.PAGE_URL AS PAGE_URL FROM HMPG_SEARCH_PAGE S WHERE S.DEL_YN = 'N' AND ( S.PAGE_TTL LIKE CONCAT('%', #{value}, '%') OR S.PAGE_CN LIKE CONCAT('%', #{value}, '%') OR S.MENU_1DEPTH_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{value}, '%') OR S.MENU_2DEPTH_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{value}, '%') OR S.MENU_3DEPTH_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{value}, '%') ) ORDER BY S.MENU_1DEPTH_NM, S.MENU_2DEPTH_NM, S.MENU_3DEPTH_NM, S.REG_DT DESC, S.SRCH_PAGE_SN DESC LIMIT 500
